about: Layouts of macOS's Preboot list of Recovery administrators, <group>/var/db/AdminUserRecoveryInfo.plist, and what the source-owner proof decides for each. Modes are octal; 'symlink' replaces the item with a symbolic link to a copy; 'missing' removes it. extraLink names the folder that gets a second hard link to the file. content: xml, binary, empty, garbage, array, oversize. Measured layouts name their source; the others are synthetic. All values are synthetic test data; no account or volume identifier from any Mac is recorded.

layouts.name: macos-26-measured
layouts.source: Measured read-only on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), 2026-11-08: group 0777 root, var 0755, var/db 0755, file 0644, 1 link, XML

layouts.name: before-macos-26
layouts.source: Synthetic: the protected group folder older macOS versions create

layouts.name: sticky-group-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic macOS 27.x candidate: the shared group folder with the sticky bit

layouts.name: sticky-db-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic macOS 27.x candidate: var/db shared with the sticky bit

layouts.name: second-name-under-protected-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic: another hard link to the file in the shared group folder; var/db stays root-only

layouts.name: owner-only-file
layouts.source: Synthetic: the file readable by root alone

layouts.name: second-name-under-shared-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic refusal: a second name in a folder others can write could be a link to another root file
layouts.expected: the file has 2 hard links in a folder others can write

layouts.name: shared-db-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic refusal: var/db writable by others without the sticky bit
layouts.expected: var/db is writable by other users (mode 0777)

layouts.name: group-writable-var
layouts.expected: var is writable by other users (mode 0775)

layouts.name: group-writable-group-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic refusal: only 0777 exactly or the sticky bit is accepted for the group folder

layouts.name: writable-file
layouts.expected: the file is writable by other users (mode 0666)

layouts.name: linked-file
layouts.expected: the file is a symbolic link

layouts.name: not-a-property-list
layouts.expected: the file is not a property list

layouts.name: array-property-list
layouts.expected: the file is not a dictionary

layouts.name: oversize-file
layouts.expected: the file is larger than 1 MB (1048577 bytes)

layouts.name: missing-db-folder
layouts.source: Synthetic: the list is absent, which macOS recreates
